title: The room's not ready
setting: Maya arrives at the hotel earlier than check-in. A different clerk, Omar, is on the desk. Bags are at her feet.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah, I know I'm a little early. I have a reservation under Chen.
lines.spoken: Yeah, I know I'm a little early. I have a reservation under Chen.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Chen, okay. Yeah, so, the room's not ready yet. I'm sorry. Housekeeping's a little behind this morning.
lines.spoken: Chen, okay. Yeah, so, the room's not ready yet. I'm sorry. Housekeeping's a little behind this morning.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's okay. Do you know about how long?
lines.spoken: That's okay. D'you know about how long?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: I wanna say forty minutes? Maybe an hour, I don't want to promise forty and then... you know.
lines.spoken: I wanna say forty minutes? Maybe an hour, I don't want to promise forty and then... you know.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: An hour's fine. Is there somewhere I can wait? Or can I leave my bag?
lines.spoken: An hour's fine. Is there somewhere I can wait? Or can I leave my bag?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: We can hold your bags, yeah. I'll tag them. And there's a lobby, and a coffee place across the street that's actually good.
lines.spoken: We can hold your bags, yeah. I'll tag 'em. And there's a lobby, and a coffee place across the street that's actually good.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh. Okay, I'll probably do the coffee place. You'll text me, or I should just come back?
lines.spoken: Oh. Okay, I'll probably do the coffee place. You'll text me, or I should just come back?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: I'll take your number and text you when it's ready. That's easier.
lines.spoken: I'll take your number and text you when it's ready. That's easier.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yeah, sorry about the wait. It's just one of those mornings.
lines.spoken: Yeah, sorry about the wait. It's just one of those mornings.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I've had those. It's really fine. Here's my ID, if you need it now.
lines.spoken: I've had those. It's really fine. Here's my ID, if you need it now.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yeah, I'll take a photo of it so we can go faster later. You want both bags tagged?
lines.spoken: Yeah, I'll take a photo of it so we can go faster later. You want both bags tagged?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Both, please. I'll keep my backpack.
lines.spoken: Both, please. I'll keep my backpack.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: You got it. Go get a coffee. I'll ping you.
lines.spoken: You got it. Go get a coffee. I'll ping you.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Thanks. I'll be across the street.
lines.spoken: Thanks. I'll be across the street.

gist.askZh: 为什么 Maya 还不能进房？
gist.askEn: Why can't Maya go to the room yet?

gist.askZh: 这段时间她可以怎么安排？
gist.askEn: What can she do while she waits?

details.askZh: 大概还要等多久？Omar 为什么不把话说死？
details.askEn: How long might it be, and why won't Omar promise a short time?
accept: he doesn't want to promise forty
他不想打包票说四十分钟

details.askZh: 行李怎么处理？她自己留着什么？
details.askEn: What happens to the bags, and what does she keep?

glue.noteZh: room's not ready 里's 和 not 都很快，yet 容易被丢掉；整句是‘还没准备好’。
glue.standard: the room is not ready yet

glue.noteZh: I wanna say 表示‘我估一下’，不是‘我想说’的争论义；wanna say 要整块听。
glue.standard: I want to say forty minutes

glue.noteZh: them 又变成 'em，I'll tag 'em 非常短，意思是给行李做寄存标记。

chunks.sayAfter: Yeah, so, the room's not ready yet. I'm sorry.

chunks.form: Is there somewhere I can wait?
chunks.meaningZh: 有没有我可以等的地方？
chunks.sayAfter: An hour's fine. Is there somewhere I can wait?

chunks.meaningZh: 我们可以帮你看行李 / 寄存行李。
chunks.sayAfter: We can hold your bags, yeah. I'll tag them.

roleplay.setupZh: 你到酒店早于入住时间，房间还没好。你要报预订名，问还要多久，问能不能放行李、去哪里等，以及他们会怎么通知你。
roleplay.aiRole: Omar, a stretched but decent front-desk clerk. He won't over-promise a 40-minute wait. He'll hold bags, take a number, and recommend the coffee place across the street.
variants: The wait might be closer to two hours.
Maya doesn't want to leave the bags.
The room becomes ready while they're still talking.
mustUse: Is there somewhere I can wait
starters: I know I'm a little early.
Is there somewhere I can wait?

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲早到入住：房间为什么还没好，要等多久，行李怎么办，Maya 去哪等、怎么得到通知。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the early check-in: why the room wasn't ready, the wait, what happened to the bags, and how Maya would be notified. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
